1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to ensure no duplicate.)

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.
